title: Battle of Lutterberg (1762)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Lutterberg (1762)", at revision 1370448311, opens: "In the Second Battle of Lutterberg, the Franco-Saxon contingent under General the Comte de Lusace were defeated by Prince Ferdinand." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2444672, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle 1762". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
